feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: 1800s law must be updated to protect 'backbone' of UK - MP
articles.summary: An inadequate law from the 19th century must be strengthened to deter saboteurs from attacking the UK's critical undersea cables and pipelines, a minister has said.

articles.title: Police given more time to question two men re-arrested in RAF Fairford investigation
articles.summary: Two men who were re-arrested as part of an investigation into a suspected terror plot near RAF Fairford can be held for up to seven days after police were given more time to question them.

articles.title: Cowardly killers who refuse to attend sentencing will face new penalties
articles.summary: Killers who refuse to attend sentence hearings could be confined to their cell for weeks or lose visiting privileges.

articles.title: Websites around the world taken down after AI detects 'critical' flaw
articles.summary: Government and business websites around the world were taken down in a bid to protect organisations after a critical software update was issued over vulnerabilities in programming language.

articles.title: Vital clues could help predict prostate cancer years in advance
articles.summary: Scientists have found clues that could help predict who will develop aggressive prostate cancer many years in advance.

articles.title: Man forced to pay shooting victim, age 9, in first-of-its-kind compensation
articles.summary: A man who was found guilty of his role in a gangland shooting that left a nine-year-old girl with a bullet lodged in her brain has been ordered to pay her compensation.

articles.title: More arrests made over death of Manchester woman
articles.summary: Three more people have been arrested over the death of Alisha Samuels in Manchester.

articles.title: Jailed former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson accused of rape inside Parliament - reports
articles.summary: Police are investigating former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson over an allegation that he raped a woman in the Houses of Parliament, the PA news agency reports.

articles.title: Actor Noel Clarke pleads not guilty to six sexual offences
articles.summary: Actor Noel Clarke has pleaded not guilty to six sexual offences.
